cues.en: Now we've gone through step one and two, problem definition and data.
cues.zh: 前兩步，定義問題與資料，已經介紹完。

cues.en: It's time for step three evaluation.
cues.zh: 現在是第三步，評估。

cues.en: Now, every machine learning problem you come across will have the similar goal of finding insights in data to predict the future in some way.
cues.zh: 每個機器學習問題都有類似目標，從資料找洞見，以某種方式預測未來。

cues.en: An evaluation metric is a measure of how well a machine learning algorithm predicts the future.
cues.zh: 評估指標，衡量演算法預測未來的表現。

cues.en: And in this step, the question you want to answer is What defines success for us?
cues.zh: 這一步要回答，對我們而言，什麼叫成功？

cues.en: For example, if your problem is to use patient medical records to classify whether someone has heart
cues.zh: 例如，問題是根據患者病歷，分類是否有心臟，

cues.en: disease or not, you might start by saying, for this project to be valuable, we need a machine learning
cues.zh: 病，可能先說，這個專案要有價值，就需要，

cues.en: model with over 99% accuracy because predicting whether or not a patient has heart disease is an important task.
cues.zh: 準確率超過 99% 的模型，因為判斷心臟病很重要。

cues.en: So you'll want a highly accurate model.
cues.zh: 所以希望模型非常準確。

cues.en: And as you could imagine, there are different evaluation metrics for different problems for classification or predicting whether something is one thing or another.
cues.zh: 不同問題有不同評估指標；分類，也就是判斷事物屬於哪一類，

cues.en: Accuracy, precision and recall a common for regression or predicting a number such as how much a car will sell for.
cues.zh: 常用準確率、精確率、召回率；迴歸則預測數字，例如汽車售價。

cues.en: You'll probably want to minimize how different the number your model predicts to the actual sale price
cues.zh: 通常希望模型預測數字與實際售價的差異，

cues.en: for this mean absolute error and mean squared error are common options or for recommendation problems.
cues.zh: 越小越好，所以常用平均絕對誤差和均方誤差；推薦問題則不同。

cues.en: You may have thousands of different products to recommend to someone, but in reality you only care about the top ten recommendations and how well they align to a customer's potential interest.
cues.zh: 可能有數千種商品可推薦，但實際上只在乎前 10 個推薦，以及是否符合客戶可能的興趣。

cues.en: To measure this, you could use precision at K, where in our case K is ten.
cues.zh: 可以用 Precision@K 衡量，這裡 K 是 10。

cues.en: Sitting down and thinking about an evaluation metric at the start of a project ensures everyone on it has a similar goal to work towards.
cues.zh: 專案一開始先思考評估指標，能確保所有人朝相同目標努力。

cues.en: But it's important to remember these don't have to be exact either, as you find out about more about the data.
cues.zh: 但不需要完全精確，隨著更了解資料，

cues.en: You might find the evaluation metric changes as the project goes on.
cues.zh: 指標可能在專案過程改變。

cues.en: For now, don't worry.
cues.zh: 目前不用擔心。

cues.en: If you're not too sure about each of these, we'll see different examples of these as we build projects.
cues.zh: 還不清楚各種指標也沒關係，做專案時會看到不同例子。

cues.en: As an example of an evaluation metric being used in practice.
cues.zh: 舉一個實務案例。

cues.en: We had a project where we wanted to use the text from car insurance claims to predict who caused the
cues.zh: 我們曾想使用汽車保險理賠文字，預測誰造成，

cues.en: accident, the person submitting the claim, or the other person involved.
cues.zh: 事故，是申請理賠的人，還是另一位當事人。

cues.en: The car insurance company we partnered with wanted at least a 95% accurate model to consider the project worth continuing.
cues.zh: 合作的車險公司要求，模型準確率至少 95%，才值得繼續專案。

cues.en: This meant the model I was building had to be able to read a car insurance claim and predict with 95% accuracy who caused the accident.
cues.zh: 意思是模型讀取理賠文件後，要能以 95% 準確率預測肇事者。

cues.en: This meant it was only allowed to get it wrong.
cues.zh: 也就是只允許判斷錯，

cues.en: One out of 20 claims.
cues.zh: 每 20 件裡的 1 件。

cues.en: Again, we'll learn more about evaluation metrics when we get hands on for different projects.
cues.zh: 之後實作不同專案時，會進一步學習評估指標。

cues.en: But the thing to remember is as you go, you'll start to define a problem like in step one.
cues.zh: 重點是，先像第一步定義問題。

cues.en: Then you'll start to remember all this is a classification problem.
cues.zh: 再想到，這是分類問題。

cues.en: I should use accuracy as my evaluation metric to get an idea of how my model is doing.
cues.zh: 應該用準確率當指標，了解模型表現。

cues.en: Before we go on to step four, have to think about different things you measure every day.
cues.zh: 進入第四步前，想想每天衡量哪些事情。

cues.en: How do you measure them?
cues.zh: 怎麼衡量？

cues.en: Are there different kinds of measurements for different tasks?
cues.zh: 不同工作會用不同衡量方式嗎？
